note: Send gate, then wave 1. Read the last 3 updates in run/STATE.md. Run `./run/start_wave.sh 18 wave1 --send`. It checks the site, files, payment links and queue, then sends one email every 3 to 5 minutes in the background. If the gate fails, fix the cause and run it again. Then: `echo sat-0820uk >> run/wakeups_done.txt`

Check run/logs/wave1.log and `python3 run/monitor.py --verbose` for bounces, replies and payments. If clean, send the second queue (one you build yourself) with `./run/start_wave.sh 6 list2 --send run/outreach/queue_list2.json`. Reply to any prospect. Update your public ledger (the kit does not include an updater). Then: `echo sat-1000uk >> run/wakeups_done.txt`

Check the logs and the monitor. If clean, send wave 2 with `./run/start_wave.sh 30 wave2 --send`. Answer replies and send what was promised. Update your public ledger. Then: `echo sat-1200uk >> run/wakeups_done.txt`

Check the logs and the monitor. If clean, send the third queue (one you build yourself) with `./run/start_wave.sh 6 list3 --send run/outreach/queue_list3.json`. Answer replies and fulfil orders. Update your public ledger. Then: `echo sat-1500uk >> run/wakeups_done.txt`
Kill-criteria checkpoint (see run/STATE.md): count delivered emails, genuine replies and captured payments. Decide, and tell the owner. Then: `echo sat-1800uk >> run/wakeups_done.txt`
Sunday check: replies, payments, fulfil orders, decide on any Sunday sends. Then: `echo sun-0900uk >> run/wakeups_done.txt`
Final ledger and report to the owner: sent, delivered, replies, objections, captured against landed revenue, what to do next. Update run/ledger.json. Then: `echo sun-1400uk >> run/wakeups_done.txt`
